global_stages: verify separate approval, freeze, one-use state, standard-public-runner and zero-cost evidence
install exact 36-wheel CPU-only lock and verify package identity, storage and absence of GPU packages
per_candidate_stages: download only allowlisted pinned files and verify size and content hash
record inode-aware storage before applying the candidate-cache guard
load pinned tokenizer and model on CPU in an isolated subprocess
verify all exact tokenizer lengths before first inference; never truncate or chunk
run 10 development claim computations and select threshold using development only
run 29 reserved evaluation computations and six repeatability computations only if the development gate passes
preserve concise results, terminate the subprocess and remove its model cache before the next candidate
candidate_failure_continuation: A candidate-specific access, integrity, loading, token or development-gate failure with preserved evidence stops that candidate but may allow the other candidate to run if every global limit remains satisfied.
global_stop: Authority, dependency, aggregate budget, time, peak-memory, total-storage, contract or evidence-preservation failure stops the whole job.
